conflictResolution: One terms-file conflict: retain the audited records and union two upstream irAE aliases. No object-literal union.

additionalDataCorrection.before: An immune-related adverse event is harm attributed to treatment-related immune activity; its name does not establish the affected organ, severity or management.
additionalDataCorrection.after: Checkpoint inhibitors can cause immune-related adverse events such as colitis, rash, hepatitis, pneumonitis and thyroid problems. Management depends on the organ and severity and may involve steroids, other immunosuppression or hormone replacement.
additionalDataCorrection.readingScope: Label section 5.1 opening management paragraphs, thyroid/hypophysitis/adrenal passages and retained prior guideline assessment. No class incidence, universal steroid instruction or individual advice.
